inputs.checklistItemText: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible
inputs.question: On the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31), are there any trees or shrubs shown within 10 feet of any transformer pad location? If trees are present near transformers, what species are they and are they identified in the plant schedule or tree list as utility-compatible?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence question first ('are there any trees shown within 10 feet') and then a label/schedule lookup question ('what species are they and are they identified as utility-compatible'), not a measurement question. While the requirement involves a 10-foot distance threshold, the agent is not asking the agent to measure that distance—it is asking whether trees exist near pads and whether their species designation appears in documentation. The measurement verification (if trees are present) would come as a follow-up.
